facts.fact: The study validated on 25 March 2026 under the Amecc project creates a Personal Identification Number (NIP) for civil registration and plans interoperability with other state systems, per We are Tech.

COM.note: Only a validated preparatory study and a 2023 law; no system procured, piloted or rolled out.
No enrolment count or share stated.
NIP is planned; the document does not say it is given at birth registration.
Nothing on who operates or owns an ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number stated.
NIP only planned in a validated study; no ID system procured, built or piloted.
Validation workshop on a civil registry study; no outside participants named and not a digital law or policy.
Study validated only; no office entering events digitally stated.
